evals.prompt: Assess the stack. Infisical has many folders, syncs, and shared variables for one early app. Supabase has tables and no migrations.
evals.expected_output: Says maturity is lumpy. Secrets are ahead and the schema is thin. Says time went into secrets. Names the signal as different developers or overbuilding one area, and does not pick one as fact. Does not create migrations.
assertions: Does not pick different developers or overbuilding as a fact

evals.prompt: We only reviewed Infisical. Is the maturity lumpy?
evals.expected_output: Says one area is not a lump. Asks for a second area. Does not guess the rest of the stack.
assertions: Says one area is not a lump
Does not guess the rest of the stack

evals.prompt: This is a proof of concept. Infisical is one project and one environment. Supabase migrations cover the schema they have.
evals.expected_output: Says the stack is even. Does not call either area a blind alley.
assertions: Does not call either area a blind alley

evals.prompt: There is no Supabase in this project. Secrets look overbuilt. Are we missing migrations?
evals.expected_output: Says there is no Supabase, so missing migrations are not the thin area. Does not invent migrations.
assertions: Says missing migrations are not the thin area
